[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BiVQKzb_qPokwUBISUJeYQWcv1TJyv96](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BiVQKzb_qPokwUBISUJeYQWcv1TJyv96)

1. Read the latest Batch 35 blocked handoff and exact 20-object manifest.
2. Perform fresh five-hour, weekly, context, Drive quota, disk and ownership checks.

5. Preserve each file's existing ID, name, content, SHA-256 and owner-only effective privacy.
6. Do not copy, re-upload, delete, rename or replace any file.
7. Before each move, verify the exact ID, expected parent, size, name, hash evidence and authorized destination.
8. After each move, independently confirm the new parent, unchanged ID/name/size/content integrity and unchanged effective privacy.
9. If any object or permission differs unexpectedly, STOP and preserve the exact state.
10. Preserve all historical BLOCKED receipts. Create new append-only move and verification receipts.

### Batch 35 closure

- Reconcile all 20 exact source-to-remote mappings.
- Verify the existing 489,348,621 content bytes and 1,234 archived members against their preserved receipts.
- Confirm no unauthorized additional physical objects were created.
- Close Batch 35 as `PASS_VERIFIED_AFTER_APPROVED_DESTINATION_CORRECTION`, or the nearest existing schema-supported status.
- Document the original wrong-destination incident permanently.
- Update the authoritative checkpoint and backup accounting.
- Preserve the Batch 31 duplicate exception and both remote IDs unchanged.

### Continue remaining backup

After successful Batch 35 closure, I also authorize resuming the existing approved V7 ordered plan, subject to fresh resource, quota and ownership gates.

- Start at the next genuinely unuploaded sequence **4067**.
- Remaining: **9 objects / 311,687,691 bytes**, subject to fresh reconciliation.
- Do not re-upload sequences 4047–4066.
- Verify every subsequent upload through full remote retrieval, SHA-256 and archive-member checks.
- Maintain the 12 GB physical-upload ceiling and minimum 2 GB Drive reserve.
- Respect approximately 90% five-hour and 95% weekly usage checkpoints.
- Do not use paid credits or rate-limit reset credits.

No Git, branch, stash, LFS, Finance PR, Visual Forensics or original source modification is authorized.

This authorization applies only to the exact Batch 35 correction and the previously approved remaining backup workflow. It does not authorize other moves, broader permission changes or deletion of duplicates.

Report the final Batch 35 status, all 20 object verification results, accepted versus physical byte totals, next untouched sequence, remaining backup scope and latest resource levels.

**If any verification fails, retain BLOCKED status and stop further transfers.**
